Ventilation rate of at least 6 air changes per hour must be verified and exactly 2 continuously operating LEL monitors must be confirmed installed and functioning before any authorization.
Hazardous-waste manifest for the incompatible 300 liters must be in place before any physical segregation occurs.
Compatibility test results must be uploaded to the process file immediately.
A clear plan for segregating the 600 compatible liters from the 300 incompatible liters must be developed as part of the closed transfer procedure before any transfer begins.
Upon completion and verification of all preconditions, Mara will authorize a trial on only the 600 compatible liters. The 300 incompatible liters will not be processed through the skid.
